messages:
maria: Kicking off rollout plan for Orchid Health private cluster tonight 02:00 UTC. Need final sign-off on pinned model v2.3.1-quant and rollback thresholds.
raj: Infra checks green on dedicated pool. Suggest canary 10% for 1h, then ramp if stable.
wayne: +1 on 10%. Rollback triggers: error rate >5% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency >600ms for 15m.
katie: Security ok with KMS rotation timing. No additional ACL changes required.
deploy-bot: Planned deploy scheduled: orchard-private-01 at 2026-05-12T02:00:00Z. Payload: --env private --version v2.3.1-quant --canary 10 --notify #eng-releases. Command: `/deploy --env private --ver v2.3.1-quant --canary 10`
maria: I'll be on-call during the window. If rollback, revert to pinned v2.3.0-quant and ping @orchid-support.
raj: I'll run smoke tests (health, token_cost, latency) at +5m after canary. Also watch the KV cache hit rate.
wayne: Add perf test: run synthetic gen at 200qps for 5m after canary succeeds.
katie: Approve from security side. :thumbsup:
maria: Approve from product/PM. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: job 98765. Logs: https://deployments.redwood/98765
deploy-bot: Canary rollout 10% complete — traffic routed to v2.3.1-quant on 3 instances
raj: Seeing a small bump in 99th percentiles on worker-7, not yet over threshold. Monitoring.
wayne: If p99 > threshold or memory growth continues for 15m, we rollback immediately.
maria: Holding for 30m. If no regressions, ramp to 50% then 100% across 2h.
raj: After 18m, memory growth on worker-7 is trending up; heap increased ~18% in last 10m. Alerting.
maria: Decision: initiate rollback due to memory leak risk on worker-7. Rollback to v2.3.0-quant now. Notify customer on-call.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: job 98766. Restoring pinned version v2.3.0-quant.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. All canaries restored to v2.3.0-quant. Incident ticket created: INC-4092.
maria: Notifying Orchid Health, creating postmortem and follow-up action items (heap dump + repro). Thanks team.
